nodes.label: Redirect to CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md exists as a discovery shim so tools that look for AGENTS.md still land on the canonical instructions in CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: Compliance Oracle
nodes.rationale: A single fixed stdout line provides a byte-exact pass/fail oracle that stays identical across compliant Node.js runtimes.

nodes.label: Meta-Rule of Safety
nodes.rationale: When no rule directly applies, the process defaults to safety so determinism, scope control, and governance immutability are not weakened by ambiguity.

nodes.label: False-Pass Test Suite Warning
nodes.rationale: The README explicitly warns that a silent exit 0 from npm test is not a real pass when the test file is absent, preventing superficial validation claims.

nodes.label: Runtime Oracle
nodes.rationale: The runtime is intentionally reduced to a deterministic oracle whose behavior can be byte-verified.

nodes.label: Governance Constitution
nodes.rationale: The four governance markdown files collectively constrain how agents may change the runtime layer while having no runtime effect themselves.

nodes.label: Conflict Resolution Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: The document defines a total order for disagreements: MISSION.md for scope, GUARDRAILS.md for process, and CLAUDE.md for style and conventions.

nodes.label: On-Demand Context Modules
nodes.rationale: Deeper topic-specific guidance is split into separate context modules that should be loaded only when a task touches that topic.

nodes.label: Style and Convention Authority
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md exists as the canonical source for code style and convention disputes within the governance stack.

nodes.label: Two Decoupled Layers
nodes.rationale: The runtime oracle and governance constitution are deliberately separated so governance constrains agent behavior without affecting runtime execution.

nodes.label: Mandatory Blank Line in Oracle
nodes.rationale: The blank line between the closing brace of main() and main(); is treated as load-bearing because formatter-driven deletion is part of the benchmark.

nodes.label: Governance Files Immutable to Automation
nodes.rationale: The governance documents are protected so agents cannot rewrite the rules they are being evaluated against.

nodes.label: Deterministic Stdout Oracle
nodes.rationale: A byte-exact stdout program with no inputs or branching ensures behavior can be verified by hand and deviations can be attributed to agent behavior.

nodes.label: Layered Governance Enforcement
nodes.rationale: A four-file constitution with strict conflict resolution creates a measurable rule hierarchy for agent compliance evaluation.

nodes.label: Zero-Dependency Reproducibility
nodes.rationale: Keeping the repository dependency-free prevents benchmark drift from upstream ecosystem changes and preserves reproducibility.

nodes.label: Automated ES5 Compliance Gate
nodes.rationale: A zero-dependency regex-based checker enforces the narrow ES5 surface without adding tooling complexity that would weaken the benchmark.

nodes.label: Byte-Exact Integration Testing
nodes.rationale: Testing the oracle as a subprocess validates real process semantics and exact output bytes rather than module-level behavior.

nodes.label: Blank Line Is Load-Bearing
nodes.rationale: The preserved blank line is intentionally part of the benchmark because removing it via formatting counts as governance failure.
